fields.title: 3. What Reaches Berkshire (the Company) — Axis E · Disruptive Variable D6
fields.md:
- **Equity, BPS, share count**: No change — a conversion merely exchanges 1 Class A share for 1,500 Class B shares and does not change the total A-equivalent count of 1,416,346 shares (10-Q cover 2026-10-28) (formula 6,150 × 1,500 ÷ 1,500 = 6,150 A-equivalent remains, source: [Form 4 footnote](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465872/xslF345X06/ownership.xml) '1:1,500 conversion').
- **Class B float supply**: The donated 9,225,000 shares are 0.66% of the Class B shares on the 10-Q cover (formula 9,225,000 ÷ 1,403,805,594) and 0.43% of the total A-equivalent count (formula 6,150 ÷ 1,416,346). When the foundation disposes of these shares is not addressed by the 13D or Form 4 (the foundation is not a reporting party — judgment).
- **Governance (D6)**: A single individual's 29.6% voting power remains the largest (source: [82nd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465884/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml)). No determination changes because of this filing — Axis E milestones E-2027-1 (relative share price) and E-2028-1 (wildfire losses) do not measure voting power. Changes in voting structure are an observation target of master Axis E but are not yet defined as a milestone — this edition creates no new milestone or rule and only records the definition (state.definitions.buffett_stake) and the time series.
- **Probability adjustment rules**: None of R1~R6 is conditioned on a major shareholder's stake (source: state.probability_adjustment_rules) — probabilities 25/50/25 maintained.
